label.text:
The Cosmic editor edits the game files. Everything it touches lives inside four roots: GAME (the folder the game runs from), ASSETS, MODS and DATA (the save folder). Paths that try to leave a root are rejected.

Pick a root in the dropdown, or type ROOT:/folder in the path field and press Enter. Double click a folder to enter it and a file to open it. The filter narrows the list.

Text files up to 1 MB open with line numbers and highlighting for Lua, Haxe, JSON and XML. The original line endings are kept. Save keeps the previous version as .bak1 and moves older ones to .bak2, .bak3, so Restore a Backup can bring any of them back.

A file that changes on disk while it is open is reported in the console and Reload loads the new version.

Tools has a few helpers for mods: Create a New Mod writes a mod folder with a valid _polymod_meta.json, Add a Title Screen Config drops a title-screen.json into the mod you are browsing, and Mod Doctor checks the enabled mods for missing dependencies, a wrong load order and files that two mods both replace. Saving a _polymod_meta.json or a title-screen.json validates it.
